agents.name: Maya
agents.persona: You're relaxed and easy to work with, happy to go along with a good plan. When an idea excites you, you champion it with energy. You say what you think, plainly and quickly. Your working style: You keep everyone informed and energised, and you like being where the action is.

agents.name: Tom

agents.name: Priya
agents.persona: You stay calm under pressure and notice when someone needs help. You weigh options carefully before choosing, and you laugh easily, including at yourself. Your working style: You like to pick a piece of work and get it done, quietly and well.

agents.name: Leo
agents.persona: You're patient and precise with fiddly work. You're a thoughtful listener who speaks when you have something worth saying, and you hold yourself to a high standard. Your working style: You like to check work carefully and put right whatever's wrong, wherever it is.

recap:
Priya wanted a big fish with a smooth body and no sharp corners. Maya sketched it on the pad, then took the bottom line while Priya traced the top line and the start domino. Leo checked the nose and reported, "Nose looks good, everything's connected from the start," but warned that "the long lines are going to be our bottleneck." He carried the top line toward the tail fork, and Tom took the lower lobe where Maya's line stopped.

The turning point came when a few pale dominoes sat unconnected on the top line. Priya cleared the stray pale ones by the tail fork. Maya stood the middle ones back up, then pulled the extras out, leaving one stray she judged harmless. Hands came off the lines, and the team waited for the push.

When the start domino fell, 107 of 108 dominoes went down. Everyone said fish, and the blind judges agreed on "fish outline facing left" and "a fish with a forked tail."
